description: This Java class 'DefaultAcknowledgementConfig' provides a default implementation of the 'AcknowledgementConfig' interface, encapsulating configuration settings related to acknowledgement timeouts and limits within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.models.acks.config' package. It includes methods for instantiation from a configuration source, accessor methods for its properties, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultAcknowledgementConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing AcknowledgementConfig interface; encapsulates acknowledgement-related timeout and size configurations, with constructors, accessors, and overridden object methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultAcknowledgementConfig from a Typesafe Config object, using fallback configuration handling.

methods.name: getForwarderFallbackTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration for forwarder fallback timeout.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackLifetime
methods.description: Returns the duration for collector fallback lifetime.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration for collector fallback ask timeout.

methods.name: getIssuedMaxBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of bytes issued.
